title: Aureline M5 backport-decision timer
description: Canonical per-domain backport-decision timer minted by the supported-line defect-ledger and backport-decision-timer lane over the frozen M5 stable-line-protection matrix. Turns a supported-line defect's backport-decision SLA into visible program truth: it records the alert scope a defect's yes/no/defer backport decision sits in — a missing backport decision (no decision recorded yet), an overdue backport decision (still unrecorded past its declared SLA), or a narrowed support claim (the missing / overdue decision forced the relevant stable/LTS claim to narrow). Names the alert scope, binds the resolved line identity, the affected-claim reference, the target-train reference, and the active alert reason so release/help, support, shiproom, program-governance, and public-proof surfaces can distinguish defects with a recorded backport decision from those whose missing or overdue decision is blocking promotion or narrowing a supported-line support claim rather than reading a defect as silently serviced. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's backport-decision posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
